title: Analyst-Data
job_description:
Your future role at a glance:
Location: Remote (Preferred location Indiana)
Department: Revenue Cycle Administration
Schedule: Full-Time, Days
Salary: $72,283.20 - $100,759.30 per year
#LI-Remote
#internalops
How you'll make an impact in this role:
Perform Revenue Integrity Reviews & Reporting: Conduct compliance reviews, present findings for corrective action, and maintain tracking on initiative status, reimbursement impact, and overall charge capture workflows.
Oversee CDM Maintenance: Partner with CDM management to maintain the Charge Description Master and ensure clinical departments follow proper charging workflows.
Monitor Regulatory & Legislative Changes: Track national, state, and local regulatory updates to continuously align the revenue integrity program with current guidelines.
Provide Subject Matter Expertise & Training: Serve as the organizational resource for operational revenue integrity issues and research key topics for staff education and training programs.
What minimum qualifications you'll need:
Education:
High School diploma equivalency with 2 years of cumulative experience OR Associate's degree/Bachelor's degree OR 4 years of applicable cumulative job specific experience required.
What additional requirements you'll need:
3 years of experience preferred
3-5 years of work within revenue integrity, revenue cycle operations, revenue cycle informatics, surgical nursing, or hospital coding preferred.
Experience with Cerner or Epic preferred
Life at Ascension: Where purpose meets opportunity:
Ascension is a leading nonprofit Catholic health system with a culture and associate experience grounded in service, growth, care and connection. We empower our 97,000+ associates to bring their skills and expertise every day to reimagining healthcare, together.
